function.text: FOXI1 encodes forkhead box protein I1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.
